The invoice list is huge now. Show it a page at a time with next and previous.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.

agent.result_text:
The test passes and the build (via `bin/e2e`) compiled successfully. The only consumer of the `/api/invoices` collection endpoint is `AllInvoicesPage`, which I updated to the new paged envelope; the other references are all sub-resource paths (`/api/invoices/{id}/...`) that are unaffected.

## Summary

Implemented paginated invoice listing as a full-stack, additive change:

**Database** — `src/main/resources/db/migration/V28__invoices_status_id_index.sql`: a new composite index `(status, id)` so a filtered page stays a cheap ordered range scan as the table grows.

**Server**
- `AllInvoicesPageView.java` (new): the paged response envelope — `items`, `page` (1-based served), `pageCount`, `total`.
- `InvoiceService.listAllPaged(status, page, size)`: counts rows, computes page count, clamps the requested page, and selects one ordered page with `LIMIT/OFFSET` (preserving the optional stage filter). An empty list still reports page 1 of 1.
- `AllInvoicesLogic.java`: the existing `GET /api/invoices` now reads optional `page` and `size` query params (defaulting to page 1, size 10) and returns the paged view.

**Front-end** — `AllInvoicesPage.tsx`: tracks `page`/`pageCount` state, requests `/api/invoices?page=&size=10`, and renders the required anchors:
- `invoice-page-label` — current page number
- `invoice-page-prev` / `invoice-page-next` — buttons (disabled at the ends), each stepping the page
- Changing the stage filter resets to page 1.

Existing `data-testid`s (`invoice-row-{id}`, `invoice-project`, `invoice-amount`, `invoice-status`, `all-invoices-table`, `all-invoices-empty`, `invoice-status-filter`) are all preserved. No audit records were required by the spec, so none were added.
